persistence: None. Request, observation and view have no Serialize/Deserialize implementations or fresh-authority record admission.

request.owner: Derived immutable borrow of original OperationPlanRecord and exact operation

fields.binding: Original full plan intent, operation sequence, network/caller/target/release/mutation request; normalized by existing owners
fields.inventory: Full original canonical InventoryRecord, including unselected relationships/metadata
fields.selected_targets: Exact original canonical selection, bounded to 1024
fields.challenge: Canonical SHA-256 value supplied by integration; freshness/unpredictability/uniqueness must be qualified externally

max_remote_observations.meaning: Descriptive per-invocation ceiling, not spending authority, a reservation, new budget or remaining reconciliation allowance

observation.owner: Trusted integration; actual observations rather than copied expected labels

fields.inventory: Complete current canonical bounded closed forest, 1..1024 targets
fields.revision: Optional opaque current authority revision digest; not continuity/fence proof
fields.evidence: Required opaque qualified evidence digest; not a signature or permission
fields.remote_observations: Actual bounded reported remote calls; each needs separate prior approved accounting

admission: Exact full inventory including unselected parents and metadata
Reported remote calls <= original descriptive ceiling

provider_errors.Unavailable: Absent provider, reject before remote effects
provider_errors.Unsupported: Cannot meet current contract, reject before remote effects
provider_errors.Indeterminate: Observation/reply/accounting failed or uncertain; retain consumed allowance/evidence and stop; no retry implied

encoding: ASCII ic-backup/membership-request/v1 followed by one zero byte
Original full plan intent: canonical 64-byte lowercase ASCII digest
Boundary: byte 0 before effect, byte 1 after effect

integration_obligations: Qualify provider and locked authenticated context, actual release/membership observations and coherent custody
Own fresh challenge uniqueness/timing; equality cannot establish freshness by itself
Consume original approved observation spending and retain per-call reservations before each remote call; the membership port implements no preflight budget or dispatch owner
Retain uncertain paid replies; do not retry/reset automatically
Qualify revision/evidence meaning and application fences separately; matching before/after revisions/hashes cannot exclude intermediate changes
Provide current controller/read permissions, same-release safety and external-obligation settlement through separately qualified contracts
Keep terminal replay effect-free; fresh verification is distinct
qualified_scope: Native exact declaration/result binding and spent-journal recovery only; no actual provider/backend, current authority, consistency fence or IC effects.
